sense.text:
This class is about patience and faith, because a lot of you are not patient enough. You want to push the envelope, not realizing that God deals with things in times and seasons. Never go above what is beyond your needs: the basics, stick with them, stick with the basics. And the basics start here: “This people have I formed for myself; they shall shew forth my praise.”

Why is the Lord saying he formed us for himself? Because we are his children, and we are going to show his praise. Where? In this earth. We come from up, and we come into this earth to show God’s praise in this earth. We are the gods of this earth.

Our job is to show God praise upon this earth, and it bears saying again: our job is to show God praise upon this earth. Sometimes it is going to look hard, it is not going to be easy, but the job still remains. That is what we were formed for, that is why we came into this earth.

And God did not leave us empty to do it. He gave us marvelous laws, wisdom, knowledge and understanding, so that we may govern ourselves first, and then govern the world, the whole earth. We have dominion over man.

precepts.why:
“Before I formed thee in the belly I knew thee; and before thou camest forth out of the womb I sanctified thee, and I ordained thee a prophet unto the nations.” Those are the leaders. We were not born by accident. People ask their mother to explain the time they were born, whether anything happened around it, but not even your own parents can explain why you are here. Your mom and your pop decided to have sex during the night, but guess what: a prophet was born out of these things, because God formed him and knew him first.

He sanctified him before he came out of the womb. Can anybody stop Jeremiah from prophesying? If God sanctified you and sent you into this earth, no one can stop you, because you were ordained from above. That is your role in this earth too: born to be a prophet in this earth, to prophesy, to praise the Lord, which is what Isaiah 43:21 says we were formed for.

But a lot of us are weak in the flesh, and we came from a low state, some of us a very low state. So it is hard to comprehend it when we tell you: brother, you are a mighty man, you are a prophet, you are a leader, you are a father. God says so, the God that created you says so. It is hard to receive because this word is not given to every vessel.

Then Jeremiah, weak in the flesh, says: “Ah, Lord God! behold, I cannot speak: for I am a child.” We always have an excuse why we don’t want to do the work. He was ordained for something, and he answers: I am just a child. We should not say that, for God can call us at any time. We use excuses not to do the work of the Lord: brother, why aren’t you doing the work? I’m sorry, my job, I have to get up five o’clock in the morning. Why can’t you do the clubhouse? Brothers always have an excuse. This walk is all about sacrifice. You are not going to be in your comfort zone. There is no comfort in this; Christ acknowledged that at a young age. The only comfort you have is in the word, doing the work of the Lord. As far as comfort in this society, there is none of that. This is a slippery place, a dark place, and our people are in a low state.

No prophet thought like that. He that used to give the king wine did not think like that, even though he was in his comfort zone at that moment. As soon as they gave him the report of the condition of his people, he felt bad. When he stood in front of the king he did not say, God gave me this position, let me just feel good in it. He said, I am going to make a request for my people. Whatever position we hold is all about Israel, brothers, not about you. The job you hold is to help your people.

So if you made it to be a captain, we should not hear nothing from you about ‘because of my job, that’s why I cannot do this.’ When they offered you the captain’s position you knew your condition; why take it? Stand up and say, I love you brothers, but I don’t think I’m ready for the position yet. If we need you to do anything for the Lord we should not hear an excuse from none of you, and if we do, you have to give up the wing of being a captain. Israel is being destroyed, so we don’t have time for weak men, weak officers or weak soldiers.

“But the Lord said unto me, Say not, I am a child: for thou shalt go to all that I shall send thee.” God said: don’t tell me you are a child, don’t tell me you cannot do it, you are going to go as I commanded you. When are y’all going to wake up and see that a lot of wisdom is given to us to be the front runners? We have to humble ourselves. Don’t get too high-minded, thinking that getting a wing is it for you. The wing comes with works, more responsibility put on your plate.

Some of you are trying to hide: I’m an officer, I don’t want nobody to see me. If you are a high officer in a camp, why is there no video made of you, why are you not preaching and teaching in the classroom or in the street? Something is totally wrong with your spirit. The leaders brought up before you all have videos on YouTube; we set up a good example. We don’t want to roll with weak men: if you are weak, move out the side, because you are too weak for that.

“And whatsoever I command thee thou shalt speak.” A lot of you get sent to different camps, you are the head of a camp, and you decide to change the doctrine, or as a young man you want to go deep: I’m the only one the Lord revealed that to. Then we look at your class and say this guy is out of the spirit, who the hell told him that? It is always an I, never a we, and you ain’t going to fix the damn thing with the I.

Christ understood that at a young age. He set up leaders with him, and after he left those leaders took over: Peter, who was a little weak, took over as a mighty man, and the rest of the apostles. You might come in a low state; our job is to build you up. But you have to be willing to take responsibility when it is given. You cannot sit in the back and let the job be done for you; that is a weak leader. When a leader shows up in a room, people feel his presence. You don’t have to tell a person you are a deacon, a captain, an officer, a soldier. Our job is to build you up and show you that you are that leader God said you are.

Look at who God gave his laws to; then we come right back to Isaiah. “He sheweth his word unto Jacob”: he did not show his word to every nation, he showed it unto Jacob, and Jacob’s name was changed to Israel. “His statutes and his judgments unto Israel.”

“He hath not dealt so with any nation.” If you have the thought that God deals with the other nations, that thought alone is a lying thought. God only gave his laws, statutes and commandments to the nation of Israel. The rest of the nations are like servants to us, but because of our sin they became master over us.

“And as for his judgments, they have not known them.” Take an example of a judgment. A guy robs a house that don’t belong to him, the cops catch him inside the house and arrest him, and in a court of law his lawyer tells the judge, my client is not guilty. You catch a man in the house and go to court to say he’s not guilty? That is not the type of judgment we are going to bring in this earth. That shows you the judgment of men is vain, no good: you catch that man stealing, and they prolong the case. This is a place of wickedness, a place of sin.

God is giving us these laws of reason: how we reason with each other, how to deal with each other. “Praise ye the Lord.” The nations have not known his judgments, and brothers and sisters, a lot of y’all don’t understand them either. That is the people he formed for himself to show forth his praise.

sense.text:
What is the will of the Lord? There are two wills upon this earth. Not three, not four, not five: only two, God’s will and your own, and you are going to know them today.

“I delight to do thy will, O my God.” Every man and every woman has to have that mindset: I delight to do your will, O God. God gave you dominion over the earth, so you have to do God’s will upon this earth, not your own. That is your job, to bring God’s will upon this earth.

“Yea, thy law is within my heart.” To bring God’s will upon this earth, God’s laws have to be in your mind. If God’s laws are not in your mind, whose will are you going to bring? Your own will. It is impossible to bring God’s will if God’s laws are not in your mind. … cannot bring God’s will, because they don’t practice God’s laws, they don’t serve God’s laws; they serve the damn devil, they are serving Satan, not teaching our people the Lord’s statutes and commandments. It is judgment for them if they don’t repent.

So God’s will is his laws, and his laws are his will. If you decide not to do God’s will, that means you are doing your own thing. Talking with a person this week, Leviticus 5:1, Leviticus 19:17 and Matthew 18 were quoted to her, and it showed that some of us are too prideful to see ourselves breaking God’s laws.

This is about pride, when you are too prideful, too smart for yourself. “The beginning of pride is when one departeth from God.” When you depart from God you are going to reject Leviticus 5:1, you are going to reject Leviticus 19:17, you are going to reject Matthew 18. It is always going to be a but. What is the but? When you tell a brother or a sister to change their ways: what about the other brother, he needs to change his way; what about the other sister? That type of mindset is of Satan. We are too prideful to humble ourselves and say, what you are giving me is the word of God, and no matter how much I want to fight against it, I have to apply what is written.

It is the same thing that happened when God showed up to Adam: the woman you gave me. Adam did not acknowledge his own fault. He was the leader inside the house, he was supposed to guard the woman; how the hell did you let her guide you? That is the spirit you find in America today. No matter how many verses you bring to a person, there is always a but.

You hear it on clubhouse all day every day, with the flattering words: y’all are great teachers, y’all know how to move in the spirit, precept upon precept, but the way you delivered the message, brother. A minute ago you exalted me, and with the same tongue of wickedness: but the way you delivered the message. Shut the hell up. Or: get that negro back where he come from, that negro needs to listen, don’t bring him on the stage. That is the spirit of our people, always coming with the flattering things. We never say we are the only ones who preach the truth. If any camp keeps God’s laws, statutes and commandments, more prosperity to you, brother; the prophet never sounds like that, because we understand the scriptures.

But one thing we tell you: you leave IUIC, you are not in the truth, because you have not repented of the folly you have done. You have not come to the brothers and sisters, you have not applied Leviticus 19:17, you have not applied Matthew 18 with the brother. Without applying Matthew 18 you are not serving the Lord, you belong to Satan. That is clear and crystal. But thank God for his grace and mercy: you have a chance to repent and come back to the truth. That is the only thing you have. If you choose not to, you can go build whatever church or congregation you want, but God is not in the mix of it, nor of the brothers and sisters you are trying to gather. Don’t play yourself. You can only gather the simple of our people; those that read and understand are going to turn back from your wicked ways.

Notice, in the seven churches in Revelation, did Christ say leave the church? Did Christ say leave your brother? In none of these churches did God say leave. God said fix yourself: apply Matthew 18, apply Leviticus 19. But for some reason we always want to point the finger, and pointing the finger is to justify their wickedness, just like Adam justified his wickedness and Eve justified hers. So it is with us today: it’s always IUIC is off. But if IUIC is off, why did the Lord put all his work in our hands to fulfill? Check YouTube, check every media outlet: we are what we say we are, the prophets of the God of the living, not the God of the dead. Write it in your notes so you don’t get it messed up next time, thinking you can come against this camp. If you see us in the mix of sin, just talk to us. We are not above God’s laws; we are going to repent and keep it moving. But when you deal in wickedness, God is going to deal with you.

“And his heart is turned away from his Maker.” A brother like that, whose heart turned away from his Maker, you cannot reason with a spirit like that. When they leave IUIC, wherever you see them, in the street or wherever, they are always speaking against us, because they are bitter.

Any time you hear somebody talk about someone who left IUIC like that, that is how you know they have bitterness in them, and how you will know whether you have it or not. There is always somebody who did them wrong, somebody who did them dirty. But they cannot find no scripture that goes against Matthew 18 or Leviticus 19:17, because they despise God’s laws, they hate God, yet they will tell you, I’m about the Lord’s business: if I left IUIC, God isn’t dealing with me? Ask yourself that question. So read the scripture about bitterness first, to be clear what the spirit of bitterness really means.

“Looking diligently lest any man fail of the grace of God.” Grace is what teaches us how to live godly. If you fall from there, you are gone. “Lest any root of bitterness”: that is how you fail of it. If the root of bitterness comes out of you, there is nothing grace can do for you. If God helps you through that, it is not many people that come out of it. So when you catch yourself, humble yourself. You have to acknowledge your sin and confess it.

The same three videos of wickedness you put on YouTube, you have to put three videos up to conquer them, acknowledging how wicked and how sinful you were. Don’t call us to the side, don’t text us; when you were doing your videos you did not call us. It is not an aside thing. Go on the same media and put the videos up. That is what is going to make you a man; until then you are just fake, like a fake dollar bill. Those that follow you are fools. But God is going to have mercy on some of them: they will catch themselves and say, I was a fool to follow these dumb negroes, and repent. If you are of God, if you are of the elect, you are going to catch yourself. If you are not, you will never catch yourself, and you will sit in the grave until the grave takes you over.

“Springing up trouble you.” What kind of trouble is it going to trouble you with? Brother, I was missed, they didn’t judge the matter the right way, I’m angry with the brother. Why? I don’t think the judgment was right. I’m just five months old in this truth, but I don’t think it was right. Do you see yourself as a baby? No, and that is why. Stay in the spirit, so you can catch yourself out of stupidity. A lot of people who just came into this truth are always looking for problems: let me see if the brother has fringes on, let me see if the sister has her fringes, let me see if she covers her head; one, two years in the body, looking for problems, while they themselves are full of problems. That is why Peter said in 1 Peter 1 you have to be born again: fix yourself first, then you can see clearly what is going on. That is what Matthew is talking about: before you worry about the beam in your brother’s eye, worry about the mote in your own eye. But a lot of brothers and sisters point the finger.

Bitterness is anger and disappointment at being treated unfairly. That is the trouble the verse speaks of: bitterness is going to bring you to the spirit of anger. That is what happened to a person talked to this week: she was full of anger, and she could not see the scripture brought to her. Leviticus 19:17, did you use that? No. Matthew 18, did you do that? No. And the next word was: but the person did me dirty too. I am talking to you, the person is not here. It is always a but. You always care for your brother and your sister; that is the job. But when a person is full of anger and bitterness, no scripture can change them. They are guilty of their charge, a hundred percent, but they feel like they were treated unfairly for being guilty of their charge.

This is love: if a brother or a sister loves you, they will bring you the scripture and say apply it, just humble yourself, you’re too prideful, you’re going to be all right. That is out of love. Hatred is not there; it is giving you the right scripture to get healed from your anger and from feeling misjudged.

Bitterness also brings resentment, resistance: you give them the scripture and they push back instead of saying, I’m going to apply it. I heard what you said, it’s true, but what about the other people that did me dirty, are you going to check them too? Yes, we’re going to check them too, but now let’s focus on you. They push against the will of God. No matter how much scripture you bring forward, they resist God’s laws with a but. That is the mind of a wicked woman, the mind of a wicked man: any time the word of God comes out, you hear a but. In that mind they will tell you, I am serving the Lord, I am of God, look at my fringes. Shalom my brother, shalom my sister: these are flattering words, you hear them on clubhouse. Shalom deacon, shalom captain, shalom officer, and then the same person stabs you in your back.

Where is your loyalty in this? The same one you showed love to, whose problems you responded to, whom you brought the scripture to heal, who reached out with questions and you reached out to them: where is the loyalty? The loyalty is, if I offend you in any way, you let me know. If the Bishop offends you, go to him one on one. If a captain offends you, go to him one on one; a deacon, one on one; an officer, one on one; soldiers, on and on. Apply what is written. It is time for us to show our loyalty, and apply what God says about how we should deal with each other.

“And thereby many be defiled.” Defiled by what? By the spirit of bitterness, because you will have a spirit of resistance. That is what will make a brother or sister believe that leaving IUIC they are still in the truth: I chose another camp to dwell with, I’m still in the truth. You are not in the truth with bitterness. You are showing by your own words that you are not in the truth, because you show a spirit of resistance when the law and the words of God come out, fighting against the brother who is trying to heal you. You will always stand for IUIC? You damn right.

You ain’t going to make it, brother, you ain’t going to make it, sister, with that spirit of bitterness, I don’t give a damn what camp you go through. Bitterness will show up in every camp you go to, because you cannot run from it: it is a spirit that has you locked inside your mind, and that is why it is hard for you to see it. You will know it in a brother or sister by this: any time you talk to them, they never stick to the present. They bring you back to the past: you did this, you did that, that person did this to me ten years ago, two years ago. They never get over it.

So the advice is: get rid of your bitterness. Go to the brother who offended you one on one, go to the sister one on one, and gain your soul. Stop playing with your soul. Feast day comes and you come glad and joyful, but you hold somebody in your heart: you are just playing yourself. You claim the leaders are evil, but there you go sitting in the feast day while we dance and have a good time. That brother, that sister doesn’t believe the scriptures. The spirit of joy is supposed to be in you when you see your brother, whom you hardly see all week because you are working. The Sabbath door is opened to you, and you open it with a spirit of bitterness, sit right inside the congregation when the bread is going to be broken, and have the nerve to take the bread and drink the wine.

Ask Judas what happened after the bread was broken. Judas was unbelieving: after he took the bread, he went to sell our Lord and Savior. That is how you know men and women are evil. You are going to meet many like Judas in this truth, as their ancestors were: the same brother you sat with, the one you told ‘watch my drink, I’m going to use the bathroom’, is the same one who speaks evil of you. We are supposed to be one unit, united under the banner of Christ, showing love and mercy to one another. We want faith when we come before the Lord asking forgiveness, but when it comes to a brother or sister, we lack faith, because we don’t believe what the scripture is saying.

We are supposed to be one unit, united under the banner of Christ, showing love and mercy to one another. When we come before the Lord we want the faith and we want him to forgive us, but when it comes to a brother or a sister we lack faith, because we don’t believe what this scripture is saying: “This people have I formed for myself; they shall shew forth my praise.”

“But thou hast not called upon me, O Jacob”: God is saying you have not called upon me, you have not praised me. The twelve tribes have not praised the Lord. I created you in this earth to praise me, but you have not done it. “But thou hast been weary of me, O Israel.”

“Thou hast not brought me the small cattle of thy burnt offerings”: this is God complaining to us. Listen, he says, I’m giving you the blueprint to allow me to bless you in any way; wherever you are, you’re going to be blessed. I’m giving you the laws so you can govern the whole planet earth and talk to me direct. We said we don’t want that, and God said you wearied him.

“Neither hast thou honoured me with thy sacrifices”: God gave us sacrifices for our sins, and we have not brought the sacrifice to him. “I have not caused thee to serve with an offering, nor wearied thee with incense.” That’s our problem, man; we always got problems.

“Thou hast bought me no sweet cane with money”: everything God told us to do, we have not done it. “Neither hast thou filled me with the fat of thy sacrifices”: there were laws for the fat. “But thou hast made me to serve with thy sins, thou hast wearied me with thine iniquities”: because of our sin, because of our iniquity, we have not served the Lord the right way.

Focus on this. The Lord just finished calling us out: we have not given sacrifice, we have not given offering. Then he turns around in the same breath and says, “I, even I, am he that blotteth out thy transgressions for mine own sake.” And you want to play with that God, the God that can blot out your sin and give you another chance? He has given us these days, he has given us grace, and we have not taken the chance to get our mind right under grace.

He has done it for his own sake. That’s why he keeps bringing these prophets out. Every prophet that comes out is going to tell you the same thing: repent, Israel, turn back to the Lord. That’s the only way your sin gets blotted out. He had to send prophets to tell you the only way he can blot out your sin is to turn back to him.

precepts.why:
Why are you in the mix of your sin? God sent men to show you your ways, and to show you what you need for repentance, so he may blot out your sin. “He that covereth his sins shall not prosper.” It’s clear and crystal: if you cover your sin, you are not going to prosper. That’s what God said.

But the prosperity it is talking about is not only a lot of wealth. A lot of people take this verse and say it’s all about prosperity; that’s not what we preach. The prosperity is learning these laws, learning the statutes and doing them. Prosperity begins with you keeping these laws. So the sin God blots out when Israel turns back to him is the same sin that keeps the one who covers it from prospering.

sense.text:
“This book of the law shall not depart out of thy mouth”: if you want prosperity, the book of God’s law shall not depart out of your mouth. That’s the beginning of prosperity. “But thou shalt meditate therein day and night, that thou mayest observe to do according to all that is written therein: for then thou shalt make thy way prosperous, and then thou shalt have good success.” The success comes when you decide to keep God’s commandments. Prosperity begins when you start to fear God’s law.

A lot of people don’t want to fear God; they just want their wealth. They want everything the world has to offer, but they don’t want to fear God to get these things. The God that created the whole universe and the whole earth gave us a law, and gave Adam dominion over the whole planet earth. He knows where the gold comes out of the earth, the diamonds, the silver, the marble, the rubies. He knows where every wealth is.

One day God might lead you to buy land or a house in a place you don’t understand: Lord, I don’t come from that town, why do you want me to buy a house there? Then one day you’re in the back doing yard work, digging, and you’re like, what the hell is this? It’s God that leads you to prosperity. He created everything and knows where everything is. Remember the wealth of Solomon: God was able to lead Solomon, with the wisdom he had, to where the gold was, where the prosperity was, where the wealth was. God is able to lead you to the stuff.

precepts.why:
You might have a good job today, then they fire you, and there you go, you lack faith: damn, I came to this truth and everything wrong is happening to me. Ask Christ when they beat him down, when they were spitting in his face. Are you going through that right now? No, you just lost a job. When Christ was crying, the scripture said it looked like blood. You have not gone through that affliction; the white man just took a job from you, and you feel trouble in your spirit. “But seek ye first the kingdom of God, and his righteousness; and all these things shall be added unto you.” You have to seek first the kingdom, then the Lord will bless you with enough to survive in this earth.

But a lot of you aim for too much, and then you start breaking God’s commandments, because money can do that to us. Friday comes, your boss already knows you keep the Sabbath, and at four o’clock he asks you: I know you keep the Sabbath, but give me four hours, I’ll make it up to you. Those four hours mean you’re breaking the commandments. What is the difference between you and Judas? Judas broke laws for money, and so do you. We have to fear the Lord with all our heart and all our soul. A lot of us use this captivity as an excuse not to fear God, but in every captivity we came up out of, it was when we feared God and kept his commandments that deliverance came. Use the captivity as your excuse? Good luck with that.

As for the job the white man took from you: the white man has no power over you when you keep these commandments. The only power over you is what God wrote down for you, and he cannot go against it. Same as Christ when he walked the earth: there was a time God gave the enemy power over his son, but while he walked doing all that prophecy they didn’t put their hands on him, because it was not yet the time. Likewise, brother, you’re going to go through some serious affliction. Stand firm, don’t be a snake, stay loyal. God is about to give you a better job, one where you can keep these commandments.

Some of you left jobs because you never showed up on the feast days, then God blessed you with a truck driving license and more money, and you do the same thing. They hardly see you on a feast day; you’re always tired. You don’t spend time with your wife and your children because you focus on money, and without knowing it you build a spirit of covetousness, a spirit of lust. Camp on the sabbath, class, leave at two or three in the morning, gone again on Sunday, and the whole week you never opened the Bible, or you open it five minutes and fall asleep. That’s the work of Satan. The wife you don’t spend time with is complaining to the sisters that her husband has developed a spirit of covetousness, the lust of the world creeping in, since he’s making more money. Be very mindful: money comes with sin. That’s why scripture says sin is in the mix between buying and selling.

A lot of you are going to leave this truth for money and for women. That is what Christ’s statement said to leaders, not to regular people: he came on this earth to build leaders. Peter was a leader, Paul was a leader, Matthew was a leader, John was a leader, and when he left, these leaders took over. A brother with no kids by an unbelieving wife says, maybe I need to give her another chance, maybe she’ll repent. Those are the excuses a weak man gives, weak in the spirit. If she’s been in the truth five years and up and doesn’t believe, there is no magic scripture; many wives left, many brothers left. Those who turn back to their wife to justify themselves: the same wife that shamed you then is the same wife that’s going to shame you again.

Read it again: “But seek ye first the kingdom of God, and his righteousness; and all these things shall be added unto you.” Get your mind right. We see things before they happen; we don’t make statements we know nothing about, and we don’t add or take away. Bishop told a brother years ago, your wife is going to leave you, and the brother laughed and made a funny smile. Where’s his wife today? Gone, she left the brother alone in the cold. The same brothers looking for magic scriptures were sitting right there when Bishop prophesied, and when the test came, none of them passed it. Those are men that call themselves leaders. It’s time to wake up and not be conquered by a woman, just like Adam was. A lot of you are going to be conquered by a woman.

And when the Lord allowed the white man to fire you, the Lord promised you another good job. Instead of looking ahead, you were so afflicted in that moment. Have some faith, have some patience, brother, and purify your soul. That’s what this whole thing is all about. “But seek ye first the kingdom of God, and his righteousness; and all these things shall be added unto you.”

sense.text: A lot of brothers don’t understand what this work takes. This work takes sacrifice. A lot of you read the scripture, but when the tests come you pass nothing. “Think not that I am come to send peace on earth”: a lot of you think that. “I came not to send peace, but a sword.” The peace Christ did not come to bring on the earth, but he brings his peace to the brothers and sisters that keep the commandments.

“For I am come to set a man at variance against his father”: against. You already know what kind of walk you’re going to walk when you pick up the Bible. You’re going to lose things, things that you love, for the kingdom’s sake. “And the daughter against her mother, and the daughter in law against her mother in law.”

“And a man’s foes shall be they of his own household.” Read it again: a man’s foes are going to come from inside his house. You must have the peace inside the house, because the main foe begins inside his house; that’s where everything began. A man knows his wife, and the sister knows her husband.

That’s why Bishop always said your wife and your children will show your character. Why leave your wife at home? Why leave your children at home? Bring them, so they may know what kind of character, what kind of man you are. You cannot hide there.

“He that loveth father or mother more than me is not worthy of me”: a lot of people are going to lose the kingdom for their mother and their father. “And he that loveth son or daughter more than me is not worthy of me”: a lot of brothers are going to lose the kingdom for son and daughter.

“And he that taketh not his cross, and followeth after me, is not worthy of me.” The things he just mentioned above, men are going to go through. You’re going to lose your children: some sisters come into this truth, leave the truth, and take the children with them. So what are you going to do, let that oppress you? In this system, by the time you hire a lawyer to get your kids you’re wasting your damn time, especially if she’s not on drugs. Brothers call me and I tell them, don’t waste that time. All she has to say to the court is that he’s into hate groups, and the case is dropped. She’s an unbeliever; her last resort is to say you’re in a cult.

That happened to me with one of my daughters. I used to pick her up Friday and bring her back Sunday. Every time I picked her up she had pants on, and inside the house I dressed her in a dress and a skirt. So she brought me to court and said he’s into this Israelite stuff, and the judge told me I could only see my daughter on Sunday, in a public place, two or three hours. The day I left the court I never saw my daughter again; all I was paying was child support. There is some sacrifice you’re going to have to take.

You have to become a man, not a boy. The knowledge of Christ is building you up to be a man, not a boy, but a lot of you have a boy mentality. You’re sharp in the scripture, but when it’s time to apply one of the precepts: brother, I’m going through things, I’ll talk to you later. Which one of us here is not going through things? Every one of us is going through things, but those are the justifications. These brothers are mighty in the street with a lot of precepts, but when it’s time to deal with the dragon at their house, they become a wimp. And those are leaders.

“One that ruleth well his own house, having his children in subjection with all gravity.” The Lord said this for a reason, and a lot of brothers read it ten times, a hundred times, but when the test comes they fail, because it is a weak mind. A man is going to go through things inside his house, just like Christ said: a man’s foes come from inside his own house.

There are brothers who come out with a lot of precepts and move in the spirit out in the street. They are mighty men in the street, but when it is time to deal with the dragon at their house, with their wife, that brother becomes a wimp. And those are leaders.

“For if a man know not how to rule his own house, how shall he take care of the church of God?” That is what God said. How could a man who gets conquered by a woman be able to rule the church of God? That is impossible. You are conquered by a woman, but you want to rule the church of God.

So a brother conquered by a woman does not need a rank. Be humble to yourself and say: let me just be a brother, because I need to build myself back up all over again; maybe I don’t understand these verses, maybe I don’t understand these classes. That is okay. Give it up, come back as a brother, and learn all over again. The Lord is merciful.

You want to be a leader of the church of God, you have to conquer the black woman first, and a lot of you don’t conquer her. Mighty men were destroyed by women: that was the weakness of Solomon, the weakness of David. Great leaders failed by women. That is why the Proverbs has a mother explaining to her son how powerful a woman really is.

That is why ‘in your patience you must possess your soul’. You are going to see a lot of great men fail in these last days, so we need to pray and fast for our brothers, that they stay in the spirit. The more work you do in this truth, the more Satan comes in full force. There are brothers laying down their life for their people, doing a lot of works, and when Satan comes for them, either they go forward or they leave the truth.

precepts.why:
“These are they which were not defiled with women”: there are going to be some of our leaders defiled by women. “For they are virgins. These are they which follow the Lamb whithersoever he goeth.” The ones who follow the Lamb are the ones not defiled, not conquered, by a woman.

Christ already gave the example. He told you that you are going to lose your wife, your children, your mother and your father for this truth. A man who is going to rule the church of God has to come through that test and not be defiled.

sense.text:
“And if thy right hand offend thee, cut it off”: there is a reason he said cut it off. Read it with a carnal mind and you say, if I cut my arm off, am I not going to be in pain? That is what the Lord is trying to tell you: you are going into serious pain, but some things you need to cut off, and a lot of us don’t know that.

“And cast it from thee: for it is profitable for thee that one of thy members should perish, and not that thy whole body should be cast into hell.” It is better you let that person go than to hold on to them and both of you perish. It is profitable for you that one member perish. You have to let her go. The same way I had to let my daughter go: I had to let her go, because these people would have come into my home and flipped my other kids. Sometimes you have to let go, to gain the one God is going to give you.

If you don’t cut it off, your whole body, your whole mind, is gone. You are going to be destroyed with that arm, with that person you are living with: you and her both destroyed, because she is ruling over you.

Read deep in the scriptures. In the garden, Adam was given dominion over the garden. Then Eve conquered Adam, and Adam was following his wife. So God had to intervene on the behalf of Adam: what is wrong with my garden? That is not the garden I gave you; that thing is out of order. That is what God is doing today to some of us. The word of God intervenes between our mind and the Creator, to teach you how to be a man: you are not a man, I am coming in to teach you how to be a man. This mind is locked by sin.

The reason you know you are Israel is that God intervened on your behalf, because you would have died without knowing you are Israel. If God let these people go, none of them would remember they are Israel, so he brings out the prophets and the leaders to preach to them that they are his chosen people, to bring them back to the mind of their forefathers. Look at every captivity: the prophets kept coming back with the same song, repent, keep God’s commandments and live. None of the prophets taught otherwise. So when a prophet tells you that you don’t have to keep the commandments of God, that is death talking to you.

When you pass the test of this thing here, it makes you a real man. But if you are conquered by a woman, other men look down on you: damn, look at the brother, a mighty man.

A brother reached out: how do I deal with my wife? The counsel was, let her go; there are sisters here who are single, and the Lord will bless you with a good sister. He said that was good counsel, and the next thing, the brother went and got his wife back and left the truth. The scripture is clear: do not take her back. He got the right counsel and still went against it, because he was weak over his children, or weak over the darkness between her two legs. He went deep into the darkness and left the truth for that. Mighty men fail for women; a young man with his whole future, gone for a woman.

“Put me in remembrance: let us plead together: declare thou, that thou mayest be justified.” The only way you are going to be justified is by keeping the commandments. Go against the commandments and you are not going to be justified.

Think about God saying, let us plead together. Look at the work of God: he already showed you how he pleads with people. He showed you in Genesis, dealing with the flood. Either you are going to keep this commandment, or I am going to flood that thing. Whatever I say is what is going to remain; you go against it and I am going to put that thing on you. He only saved eight souls with Noah. And he has prophesied for the last day how he is going to plead with you: with fire. That is why Peter said to be very mindful, seeing what kind of man he is. You don’t want to play with the Lord. This thing here is going to be straight fire.

So what are you going to do? You need one of a thousand to talk to. Some sisters have been in the truth two, three years with nobody to talk to, and wonder why they bugged out; brothers the same way. Three years in the truth with no counsellor? You need counsellors, a brother you plead with, because of the work of Satan. You need that brother who calls you in the moment you are about to do something stupid: shalom brother, I’m coming to get you. Who do you think made the man call you? God made the man call you.

There was a brother I wanted to call the whole week, and Satan held me down. Two weeks later I called him, and he said, thank you for calling me, because I was thinking so much evil; you brought me back to my senses. The day I called, he was about to do something stupid, and the Lord woke him up: don’t do that. That is the power of the mighty God when you keep this commandment.

“Thy first father hath sinned, and thy teachers have transgressed against me.” The job of the teacher is to teach us, so if the teachers transgressed against God, what kind of teaching is that? God says, your father sinned against me, so now I am the one who can blot out your sin, and I am going to send these prophets out to teach you how to get out from your sin. But a lot of us don’t want to hear that, and a lot of us don’t apply these commandments.

“Therefore I have profaned the princes of the sanctuary”: it is God doing all these things. “And have given Jacob to the curse, and Israel to reproaches.” He has given Jacob to the curse, and that curse is what Deuteronomy 30 speaks of.

precepts.why:
“And it shall come to pass, when all these things are come upon thee, the blessing and the curse.” We were to inherit two things: both the blessing and the curse. That is all the scripture is saying.

“Which I have set before thee, and thou shalt call them to mind among all the nations, whither the Lord thy God hath driven thee.” He set the blessing and the curse before us, and we must call these things to mind among all the nations we are going to be captured under. We were driven because of our sin.

The key is verse 2: “And shalt return unto the Lord thy God.” It is also prophesied that we are going to return. We inherit the curse and the blessing, but we also return to the Lord. “And shalt obey his voice according to all that I command thee this day”: you go off, but it is prophesied you turn back to him and obey his voice. “Thou and thy children, with all thine heart, and with all thy soul.” That is what we are doing right now: returning, keeping the commandments, and bringing our children, our daughters and our wives back to these laws. But you have to know that a lot of people ain’t going to make it.

“That then the Lord thy God will turn thy captivity, and have compassion upon thee, and will return and gather thee from all the nations.” With God’s compassion he will gather us. That is the compassion he has for us today: we are under grace, and he is telling us, get it together, I am about to burn that place out. So don’t look at your situation like it is a coincidence. You sit in that seat, you are worthy of that seat, because God did not make a mistake; but it is up to you to see what God is calling you to do. A lot of us come in here and do what the hell we want, nothing the Lord said to do, then wonder why we are back in the world: it is because you rejected what God is trying to establish in this earth. He is telling you to repent for a reason. What are you playing for? That little dollar, that little pound, gold, diamonds? These things are not worth nothing. You are going to give your soul for the dollar bill? God is calling you back in for a reason.

“If any of thine be driven out unto the outmost parts of heaven, from thence will the Lord thy God gather thee, and from thence will he fetch thee: And the Lord thy God will bring thee into the land which thy fathers possessed, and thou shalt possess it.” Look at our captivities: Babylon, then the Greeks, then Rome, and now America. Did the Lord ever lie to us? He said he will bring us back when we observe and do his commandments.

When we apply and do his commandments, we are connected to everything else: what we prophesy becomes active. When the leaders up here prophesy, that is us reading the scripture and telling you what is going to happen in the body. You think class has no meaning, you go home, you don’t study, there is no foundation in you, and when the devil comes, it is you he grabs. Paul said there would be heresies among us, so we prophesy to you that there will be heresy in here: brothers and sisters coming not for the gospel but for trouble, talking about others. Your job is to ask, who told you that, why are you bringing that nonsense to my door? It is for you to protect your soul.

sense.text:
“And the Lord thy God will circumcise thine heart, and the heart of thy seed, to love the Lord thy God with all thine heart, and with all thy soul, that thou mayest live.” You see that: that thou mayest live. That’s what the law do, man: the law will give you life. That is what Moses said, I set before you life and death, that you may live.

What is it to circumcise your heart? To cleanse it and put these laws in there. His laws are going to be inside your mind, and when the laws of God are inside your mind, brother, you’re going to know exactly what to do. People don’t understand that.

This is because of our sin, brother: this is what God did to us. “Come down, and sit in the dust, O virgin daughter of Babylon, sit on the ground: there is no throne, O daughter of the Chaldeans: for thou shalt no more be called tender and delicate.”

Learn something about your enemy. Your enemy is the so-called white man; today in America we’re facing them. They are our enemy according to God’s words. It’s not a personal attack: they are the enemy of the Israelites.

You only got two wills upon this earth: either you’re going to do your own will or you’re going to do the will of God. Your own will is connected to the other nations, because they’re doing their own will, serving other gods; God gave that to them, to follow after their own will. But for you, the will of God is to have God’s laws in your mind. When you know God’s laws, you’re going to govern the world you’re living in. That was not given to the nations: you were given dominion over the earth, to guide the earth as God said to do it.

Focus on what Christ said, then focus on your enemy and what the job of your enemy is. Some of you think his job is to protect you, to help you. No: the enemy’s job is not to help you in any type of form.

precepts.why:
“Thy kingdom come. Thy will be done in earth, as it is in heaven.” God wanted that from the beginning with Adam: that’s how he wanted the earth to be governed, by his laws and his commandments. But when Adam did what he did, Adam had to suffer, Adam had to go through what we’re going through today.

God’s will must be done on earth as it is in heaven, and God’s will is his commandments. That is the will set against the will of the nations, our enemy, who serve their own will and their own gods.

sense.text:
For you to do God’s will on this earth, you’re going to have to have it in your mind. That’s why our people don’t understand: when you say you’re not here to keep any laws, you cannot lead anyone in this earth. You’re going to lead them by your imagination, by your mindset, by your own will. This is the will of God: we keep his commandments.

“I thank God through Jesus Christ our Lord. So then with the mind I myself serve the law of God.” What do we have to serve? The verse doesn’t say serve religion; it says we got to serve God’s laws. And the Christian church ain’t serving God’s laws. He said serve the law because it’s a work that has to be done in God’s laws.

precepts.why:
“But his law have they despised, and denied his covenants; in his statutes have they not been faithful, and have not performed his works.” We just read that we have to perform his work. That’s why he said we must serve: when you serve somebody, you do what the hell he wants you to do. We must serve the law in our mind.

When we serve the law, we’re going to keep the sabbath, we’re going to know about the feast of tabernacles, the feasts of the Lord, because we’re serving the Lord. But when you’re serving the white man, you’re going to go to church on Sunday, worship Christmas, Thanksgiving, Mother’s Day, Father’s Day. Those are the will of the Gentiles, for you to serve their god.

When you leave your God, you go serve that god. When God gives you into the hands of your enemy, he’s telling you: since you don’t want me to be your God, go serve them as your god. So the white man has been a god to our people. Why do we think free welfare and free housing is all about? Because he’s your god; he’s feeding you with something.

sense.text:
“And every one that shall be saved, and shall be able to escape by his works.” Not ‘don’t do nothing, brother, as long as you accept Christ to be your Lord and Saviour you don’t have to do nothing.’ That’s a lie; that’s the spirit of Satan.

We all want to be saved. People say, I know the Lord, I’m saved by the blood of Jesus Christ, sanctified by the blood. No: if you’re saved by the blood of Christ you’re going to keep the commandments. Those words are to get you outside of keeping commandments. What about the sabbath? No, I do Sunday. How the hell are you saved by the blood of Jesus Christ? If you’re saved by the blood of Jesus Christ you ain’t going to do Sunday church, you ain’t going to do Christmas, because it’s against God’s laws; you’re not going to do Halloween, Valentine’s, Mother’s Day, Father’s Day. Why do you think Christ said the truth is going to set you free? In the blood of Christ you are delivered from your mindset.

“And by faith, whereby ye have believed.” That’s why it was said, show me your works, I’ll show you my faith. It’s the same verse, saying the same thing Ezra said. The work and the faith go hand in hand. Ezra said by his works and by faith.

Whose is the faith today? Christ is the faith. By your works, keeping the commandments; by faith in Jesus Christ: that is what the New Testament is all about. At one time the faith we had to have was animal sacrifice: when you sinned you had faith God forgave your sin. Now Christ picked up the blood sacrifice, so now we have faith on Christ.

precepts.why:
It’s the same verse; the language has not changed. It’s the same song we’ve been singing since the captivity, and we’re singing the same song today in America. The prophets have not lost a beat.

“Here is the patience of the saints: here are they that keep the commandments of God, and the faith of Jesus.” Jesus Christ is the faith, and the commandments represent the work. It’s the same thing the prophets speak: go back to Ezra, “And every one that shall be saved, and shall be able to escape by his works, and by faith, whereby ye have believed.” Your work is keeping the commandments, and the faith is through Christ, in Christ.

sense.text:
“I thank God through Jesus Christ our Lord.” We have to thank God through Jesus Christ our Lord because at one time we were lost. Jesus Christ intervened on our behalf. That’s what Christ said: he was sent to the lost sheep of the house of Israel.

“So then with the mind I myself serve the law of God.” It’s only through Christ you’re able to know that. The Christians, those who follow religion, don’t know that; those who follow Islam don’t know that. Christ, who intervened for us, is telling us the mind has to have the law. You want to know if there is a God on earth? You have to serve God’s laws in your mind, because that’s where the war begins; that’s where everything begins. Why does God want you to upload these laws in your mind? There’s a reason.

precepts.why:
There is a war going on inside that mind. “For from within, out of the heart of men, proceed evil thoughts.” Now we learn something about the mind: evil comes from inside the mind. That’s why they tell you to upload the law into the mind, because otherwise you’re going to go according to your own mind and do whatever you want to do. Upload the law, man: inside the same mind evil thoughts are coming out.

So if you got God’s laws inside the mind, that is what will help you to control your thoughts, to control your emotions.

Everything begins inside that mind, brothers. Everything you see begins in the mind. “And God saw that the wickedness of man was great in the earth, and that every imagination of the thoughts of his heart was only evil continually.” Every imagination of his thoughts, in his mind, continually to do evil: that’s what the mind possesses. And out of the same mind good comes too; there are going to be some good thoughts. But the Lord wants you to know where the beginnings are: your mind. It’s a war going on.

That’s why you have to constantly upload these laws, man. Soon as you open the Bible, five minutes, you go to sleep: what are you going to upload, sister? You get up in the morning and you hardly do the four chapters a day; you hardly do the 15 minutes with the captain. It only takes five, ten minutes. Build a foundation, a solid foundation.

Don’t build your house where any flood that comes, you’re going to go with it. Build your house upon the solid of God’s laws. Some of us can become the one you put your hope on: if the deacon left, I left; if the captain left, I left; if an officer left, I left; if a soldier left. Brothers, sisters, don’t be a fool: don’t build your foundation upon no man.

Get up in the morning and don’t just have the white man inside your mind. Give yourself ten minutes, twenty minutes, half an hour if you can. Relax, drink a nice tea, because you’re about to face war out on the streets. The white man declared war. Y’all only drink tea when you’re sick: that’s crazy. It’s a routine because it’s war. The Lord is giving you the remedy. As leaders we’re not telling you something we’re not doing: in the morning make sure you drink your tea, in the afternoon if you can, and at night before you go to sleep; it’s going to help your system.

“But I see another law in my members, warring against the law of my mind.” There is a fight inside that mind; it’s warring. There is a war going on inside your mind. “And bringing me into captivity to the law of sin which is in my members.” You go after your flesh, and that flesh is going to bring you back to captivity. Where does the captivity begin, brother? The captivity begins in your mind.

That’s what bitterness will do: bitterness captures your mind. That’s why it’s hard for you to understand when a brother brings a verse to help you, when a sister brings a verse to help you.

That’s why these classes are playing all day, every day, seven days a week. It’s not a coincidence. Your job is to listen to these classes, man, and constantly endure in this truth. Don’t let your thoughts bring you anywhere else.

You have to constantly endure in this truth: those that overcome. “But that which ye have already hold fast till I come. And he that overcometh, and keepeth my works unto the end, to him will I give power over the nations.” We just read it in 2 Esdras chapter 7 and in 2 Esdras chapter 9: it’s talking about the work. Those who keep my works: it’s a work being done in Christ.

The Christian church says you don’t have to do the work; as long as you’re sanctified by the blood of Jesus Christ, you’re good. That’s not what the scripture just said. Christ says you must keep his works unto the end, and to him will he give power over the nations.

sense.text:
Back to what the Deacon was bringing forth. Brothers and sisters online, you have to come out for your own understanding. That’s why uploading God’s laws, the 15 minutes with the captains, the clubhouse, is very important for brothers and sisters to attend.

“For the thoughts of mortal men are miserable.” God already got it detailed: your carnal mind, your Americanized Babylonian mind, is miserable. You think you know it all, you think you got the game plan, the ultimate plan, but God says your way of thinking is carnal. God told you his thoughts are not your thoughts. This is why he has things in place, why the classes are in place, why class today is important. But a lot of brothers are in bed asleep, still not paying attention.

“And our devices are but uncertain”: our ways, our schemes, our plans and goals are uncertain. I want to do it my way, I don’t want to do it the way God said. I don’t have time for the wife, I don’t have time for the kids, I don’t have time for the truth; all I have is five minutes and I’m going to sleep.

“The corruptible body presseth down the soul”: this carnal flesh you’re in, this worldly estate, this shell you’re in, presses down. And “the earthy tabernacle” weighs down the mind: the carnal body weighs down the mind, the lust of the flesh weighs down the mind, the thoughts of man weigh down the mind.

Your mind is supposed to be according to God’s laws, not what the world has to offer: not damn Christmas and damn New Year’s and damn Thanksgiving and how many presents can I get from X, Y and Z in the family. You got to have your mind according to what the Lord’s mind is. You got to be renewed in your mind to be able to get the hell up out of here.

Think about how heavy that is, brothers. If you try to control yourself from the outside, you cannot. You got to control you from inside, and God is telling you how: upload these laws. The law is to help you fight your body inside, because the outside world is already temptation everywhere. When you control it from within, the outside is easy, just a regular picture: you know exactly where to go, make the left, make the right. Through the spirit of the Lord and his laws you are able to control the flesh.

Think about how powerful the mind is. You see a man you went to middle school with, you haven’t seen him for 25 years, and you stare at him and your mind goes so deep, at a speed no man can understand, and finds him: he was in my middle school, his name is this. That’s how deep that thing is. If you can control it, it becomes a good tool for you to use, and God gives you power in these laws to control your thoughts before they manifest.

Thou shalt not steal: a thought pops up, that’s the white man’s stuff, you can take it, he did this to me. Brother, you’re still a thief. The thought will pop up; I was at the dollar store and the cashier gave me a twenty too much in my change, and I said, sis, you gave me too much. That was my temptation right there. Two thoughts pop up, either give it back or just take it, and the right thought overcomes the negative thought. That’s how the mind works: not every thought you just let channel through you.

And when a brother says, brother, you’re off, come to your senses, don’t get mad at the brother who is trying to fix you. It’s like you keep falling in the water and he keeps lifting you up, and you say don’t touch me. The brother able to bring you to your senses according to the laws of God is the brother you’re supposed to double love; that’s the sister you’re supposed to be hanging with, the one who will not hold sin from you.

“My son, if thou come to serve the Lord, prepare thy soul for temptation.” These are serious things we are facing in this world. Anybody and anyone can become your temptation; anything can become your temptation. God is telling you: this is a world of temptation, I am giving you my laws and sending you into a world of temptation, and the devil will tempt you.

Focus on the word ‘if’. Some of us are not going to serve; we are going to do our own thing, because you have the choice. A lot of people don’t come to serve the Lord. Some people come to serve money, some come to serve a woman, some come to serve a car. Some come to serve religion: Islam, Christianity, Buddha. Some come to serve democracy, some come to serve education, all types of wicked things. That is why God says you have to know how to serve him, and he already gave you the law to serve him by. You are not waiting on an angel to come and tell you to make the left or make the right; he already gave you a law. Serve his law.

“Set thy heart aright”: set your mind right. Your mind has to be right for you to come and serve the law, because if you don’t get your mind right you will get caught up in temptation. Christianity is temptation, Islam is temptation, religion is temptation; all these things are temptation.

“And constantly endure”: it is a constant fight. It is not a thing you just pick up and win the victory over. You have to believe in the process and it is going to work for you, because the God that created you is giving you the medicine that can heal you. Don’t go left, don’t go right: focus. A lot of you are not focused, and that is why it is hard for you to open the Bible; you read one verse and you are already knocked out.

A lot of you let money be your god. It is good to make money, because money is a defense, but only use money for a defense; do not serve money. Don’t be out working seven days, show up on the sabbath, take a shower, go to sleep, then come up for class on Saturday: where is the time for your spouse? As a godly man you are supposed to know that already. A congregation was destroyed before because brothers were thinking about 10k, 20k, 30k, and a lot of those brothers did not make it; they are back in the world today. If the Lord gives you a gift, use the gift: use the world without abusing it.

“And make not haste in time of trouble.” When trouble comes your way you have to face it, but y’all make haste and make poor decisions when trouble comes: you see an officer come out and you say, if he is out, I’m out too. You don’t know how long leadership was talking to that officer or how much mercy they showed him behind closed doors. All you see is the judgment, and then a dumb thought pops up in your mind: I don’t like the judgment, where was the mercy? Mercy was reaching out to each one of them, and they did not grab hold of it. When two captains call you to the line, they are not calling you to know the color of your teeth or your skin; they have to get the truth out of you, and it is the first lie, the second lie, the third lie, then ‘am I in trouble?’ The Spirit of God will chase you into every corner, and the Spirit of God will win.

precepts.why:
“Surely he knoweth your inventions”: God knows what you think inside your mind, “even them that sin, and would hide their sin.” This is why the hasty, lying spirit in time of trouble cannot win: the Spirit of God chases you in every corner.

“Therefore hath the Lord exactly searched out all your works, and he will put you all to shame.” When the pictures of those sisters and brothers were put up, that was the shame God brought on them, because God searched out their works. In class a sister who spoke evil would be looked at straight until she was uncomfortable, so she might come to her senses and see that what they were doing was evil, but when shame came she was out so quick. You can win, but you cannot hide, because God will search out your sin. That is why we must fast and pray, stop pointing the finger, and fix ourselves.

You have your own personal sin you are dealing with, and then you want to put the charge on leadership. God does not take it lightly when you speak evil of leadership; God despises that thing and hates it, because God gave these men responsibility, and when you go against the government God is trying to establish on earth, God will bring your sin forth. You can blame me, you can blame IUIC, but at the end of all things: love your neighbor as you love yourself. You are better off putting a rope around your neck with a big stone on it and jumping in the sea, because God’s spirit will search you out in every way. A little bird will come and tell leadership what was said, and then the proof comes forward, because the law of Moses says that by two or three witnesses everything is established.

Sin is a network; sin needs partners. You are not going to sit at home with it; you seek partners. You say something to a brother and see if he catches it, then you reach out to a sister to see if she gets what you just said. That is temptation, so be very mindful of what people say to you. People will make you believe you didn’t see what you saw and didn’t hear what you heard: ‘trust me, trust me, that’s not what I meant.’ That is witchcraft. They cry ‘where was the mercy?’, but behind the scenes they were warned so many times: called personally and told to get their mind right because the officers were complaining.

In the day of judgment those same leaders will be sitting in the judgment seat, and you will have nothing to say. When judgment comes they blame the deacons and on and on, instead of saying, the Lord shamed me, I am going to make a comeback, repent and get my mind right.

sense.text:
Some, instead of repenting when the Lord shames them, set their mind on revenge. “He that revengeth shall find vengeance from the Lord.” Man did not write that scripture; God did. You seek to take vengeance when you did not see that the Lord brought you to your shame so you would repent, and God’s spirit is going to judge your simple behind. Vengeance belongs to him, so when you think about vengeance, God already has your number. God does not play with you. Look at those men in Austin who were always aiming for judgment: God Almighty pulled the cards on each one of them. If you don’t want the vengeance of the Lord coming to you, apply Matthew 18; it is going to help you.

“And he will surely keep his sins in remembrance.” When you aim for vengeance, your sins still remain. You have a covetous spirit in you, and your brother has a covetous spirit; worry about your own. He is trying to fix himself while you are aiming to destroy him. You have a lust: fix you. The Lord says your sin still remains; that is not my word, that is what God said.

A lot of brothers want to take things into their own hands: I can do what the hell I want to do. Pay attention to what God said: “Woe unto you that have lost patience!” You lost patience upon your brother, upon your sisters, upon yourself. Who are you supposed to put your trust in? Put all your trust upon the Lord.

“And what will ye do when the Lord shall visit you?” When you aim for vengeance, what will you do when the Lord visits you and puts his spirit on you to judge? Who are you going to pray to? You have been playing games since the … captivity, and it is the same spirit. It was the same spirit in Babylon when God said turn ye from your evil ways and I will protect the land, and y’all went into Egypt thinking you could escape the judgment. The same spirit under the Persians, when God afflicted you; the Greeks took over and you still did not get your mind right; then you said you would make a covenant so that whatever bad thing comes they would protect you, and when 70 A.D. came God proved you a liar and judgment came.

That same spirit comes here today, thinking it can repent under the white man. Class after class, brothers and sisters are still doing the same thing they did in Egypt. This is a new Egypt; America is the new Egypt. Ask yourself whether you are going to get your mind right this time, because this Egypt is going to be destroyed.

Peter warns of the judgment that is coming on this earth, on this Egypt. Every captivity you came with the same vengeance spirit and the same bitterness spirit, and then you wonder why you are not with IUIC: you have too much bitterness in you to see that IUIC is of God.

“But the day of the Lord will come as a thief in the night.” If you know that, you should get your mind right, because you are not going to know the day. “The heavens shall pass away with a great noise”, “the earth also and the works that are therein shall be burned up.”

“Seeing then that all these things shall be dissolved, what manner of persons ought ye to be in all holy conversation and godliness”. Seeing what is coming upon this earth, what manner of person should you be? Should you be like your forefathers, who broke every law and found themselves in captivity, in mind and in body? No. Your conversation should be holy, and you have to live in godliness.

“Looking for and hasting unto the coming of the day of God, wherein the heavens being on fire shall be dissolved”. The Most High is going to burn it up with fire. So what manner of conversation should you have? A holy conversation. Stay in the spirit. Let’s endure together, pray for one another, fast for one another, and stop pointing fingers, because fingers cannot help you in the day of judgment.
